name: 公園
description: A sunny park. A person is playing with a dog and a ball on the grass.

elements.label: 男の子
elements.partial: a person or someone, without saying it is a child

elements.label: 犬がボールに向かって走っている
elements.accept: the dog is running toward or chasing the ball, e.g. the dog is going to get the red ball
elements.partial: mentions the ball, or says the dog is running, without connecting the dog and the ball

elements.label: 男の子が走っている
elements.accept: the boy is running or jogging, e.g. on the stone path
elements.partial: the boy is walking, or says someone is running without saying who

elements.label: 桜の木
elements.accept: cherry blossom tree, cherry tree, sakura, a tree with pink flowers
elements.partial: a tree or trees, without saying it is a cherry tree or pink

name: 教室
description: A classroom at school. A teacher is giving a lesson and the students are listening. Some students are absent, so a few desks are empty.

elements.label: 先生
elements.partial: a woman or an adult standing in front of the class

elements.label: 先生が黒板を指している
elements.accept: the teacher is pointing at the blackboard, or teaching or explaining at the blackboard
elements.partial: mentions the blackboard, or says the teacher is teaching, without connecting the teacher and the blackboard

elements.label: 男の子が手を挙げている
elements.accept: a boy or a student is raising his hand, putting his hand up
elements.partial: says someone wants to ask or answer a question without saying a hand is raised

name: 駅前
description: The square in front of a small train station. The station building has a big clock on its tower and a blue sign. A woman in a beige coat is walking out of the station, pulling a pink suitcase. A man in a dark suit is waiting at the bus stop and looking at his phone. A yellow taxi is waiting on the road next to a crosswalk. There is a clock on a pole in the square, a red vending machine, a blue bicycle, trees in round planters, flower beds, and street lamps.

elements.label: 駅前で
elements.accept: station, train station, in front of the station

elements.label: 女性
elements.partial: a person or someone walking out of the station

elements.label: 男性
elements.accept: man, businessman, a man in a suit
elements.partial: a person or someone waiting at the bus stop

elements.label: 女性がスーツケースを引いている
elements.accept: the woman is pulling or carrying a suitcase, e.g. a traveler with her luggage
elements.partial: mentions a suitcase or luggage without connecting it to the woman

elements.label: 男性がバス停で携帯を見ている
elements.accept: the man is looking at or using his phone, e.g. while waiting at the bus stop
elements.partial: mentions a phone, or says the man is waiting at the bus stop, without saying he is looking at the phone
